privileged_info_for_vlm: The alignment length for these 8 Cytochrome c sequences is 112 columns. At a 100% threshold, there are 46 completely conserved positions. The longest continuous conserved motif is 'VQKCAQCHTV' (length 10), located at positions 11-20 of the alignment.
